# FDG9059

> DO NOT put dependency property validation logic in the property’s accessors. Instead, pass a validation callback to `DependencyProperty.Register` method.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.3.3 Dependency Property Validation.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate of its own: validation in an accessor of a dependency property is code other than the standard code, which FDG9057 reports; whether that code is validation is judgment, and the validator does not let a rule list another rule's analyzer diagnostic.

## From the book

```csharp
public static readonly DependencyProperty TextProperty =
  DependencyProperty.Register(
    "Text",
    typeof(string),
    typeof(TextButton),
    new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty),
    value => value != null); // validation
```
